# Purchased-part CAD provenance

The project uses actual catalogue parts and package dimensions. CAD describes **nominal geometry**, with the explicit detail limits below. Detailed bearing/cable data unavailable online uses the user-authorized best approximations. The fit budget and first-prototype checks are recorded separately; production validation has not been performed.

| Model | Source and dimensions | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Waveshare 19192 | [Official 3D archive](https://files.waveshare.com/upload/4/49/1.28inch_LCD_Module_3D_Drawing.zip), `0508.stp`, 2021-05-08; [product](https://www.waveshare.com/product/1.28inch-lcd-module.htm) | Original STEP retained as `step/Waveshare-19192.stp`. Unscaled tessellation: 40.453106×37.5×9.2 mm. Supplier's simplified solid includes PCB, front, rear connector and four mounting bosses. Fine connector/contact details are absent from the supplier file. Colours are ours. |
| JST B6B-PH (installed) / S8B-PH (historical) | KiCad `Connector_JST.3dshapes`; [official JST PH drawing](https://www.jst-mfg.com/product/pdf/eng/ePH.pdf) | Pitch 2 mm; PH6 width 13.9 mm/top-entry height 6 mm; PH8 width 17.9 mm/side-entry height 4.85 mm in the STEP. Through-hole tails in the derivative OBJ are trimmed to 0.8 mm below a 1.6 mm PCB. Original untrimmed STEP retained. |
| ICs and passive packages | KiCad package STEP files in `step/`; per-file URLs in `models.json` | LQFP48, narrow SOIC8, SOT23-5/6, SC70-6, SOD323, 0402/0603/0805. Lead geometry and package sizes come from those STEP files; material colours are ours. These are package-level models, not serial-number-specific manufacturer solids. |
| XUNPU USB-C | Exact `tsci import --jlcpcb --use-exact-footprint --download C2909598` assets, included under `imports/jlc/TYPEC_309_ACP16L65/` and `vendor/` | Supplier OBJ/STEP geometry is unscaled. The project aligns the CAD Z origin to the 0.09 mm SMT seating plane, giving 3.161 mm above PCB against the 3.16 mm drawing. All copper/drills remain byte-for-byte from the import; standard 0.60×1.50/1.60 mm plated slots replace the original short-slot part. The watertight STEP tessellation supports collision checks. Historical unused C165948/C720477 assets are retained only as old references; neither is installed. |
| TCUT1600X01 / TCUT1600X01_A | [Vishay drawing p.6](https://www.vishay.com/docs/84174/tcut1600x01.pdf) | Datasheet-derived nominal 5.5×4×5.7 mm, 3 mm optical gap, 4.5 mm beam height. Fine moulding, optical lenses and lead-form details omitted. |
| Omron B3U-3000P | [Omron B3U datasheet](https://omronfs.omron.com/en_US/ecb/products/pdf/en-b3u.pdf); KiCad `Button_Switch_SMD.3dshapes/SW_SPST_B3U-3000P.step` | Side-actuated SMT model; body 3×2.5×1.2 mm, total terminal span 4 mm, actuator reaches local +Y1.95 mm. Footprint uses 0.9×1.7 mm lands at X±1.7 mm; rotated 180° on the PCB to face front. Collision tessellation preserves the valid STEP’s distinct coincident seam edges through Manifold half-edge pairing; vertices and dimensions are unchanged. E3 keeps this unscaled package on the front tab. E7 uses an 8×4 mm captive forked cap with guides and stops inside the circular shell, a 0.2 mm nominal gap and a 0.6 mm travel stop. The static housing is checked separately from the projecting actuator. Actual slide friction, actuator tolerances, safe overtravel and force require prototype verification. |
| Würth 61300821021 / C5517754 | Exact JLCPCB-imported OBJ/STEP under `imports/jlc/A_61300821021/`; [manufacturer drawing](https://www.we-online.com/components/products/datasheet/61300821021.pdf) | Fitted right-angle 2×4 male header, 2.54 mm grid, nominal body height5.08±0.2 mm, 6 mm mating posts and 3 mm original board tails. The retained import footprint has Ø1.1000232 mm holes and Ø1.70 mm annuli; manufacturer recommended Ø1.02±0.05 mm holes are smaller. No copper/drills changed. The canonical mesh subtracts datum (0.0000127,4.8000031,−0.280006) mm and trims only tails to 0.8 mm below the board. No axis scaling. `generate-display-header.py` reproduces the derivative from the retained STEP, preserving coincident seams. |
| Supplied LCD lead | [Waveshare package list](https://www.waveshare.com/product/1.28inch-lcd-module.htm), [manufacturer cable photo](https://www.waveshare.com/img/devkit/accessories/PH2.0-wire-20cm-8PIN.jpg) | Includes PH2.0 8-pin / eight individual female jumper ends, nominal20cm. Both factory ends retained. E10 shortens the middle and models eight insulated inline solder joints; no replacement cable or crimp kit. Display housing uses nominal PHR-8 geometry6.85×17.8×4.5mm, estimated seated reachX14.8/axisZ11.7mm. Individual female ends use nominal14.5×2.54×2.54mm housings,0.2mm body gap and5.8mm post engagement. These are authorized approximations, not actual Waveshare housing/contact CAD. Wires renderØ1.2mm, checkØ1.5mm; nominal static minimum centreline radius3.3mm. Finished splice sleeves reserveØ2×6mm. Free paths25.6–27.9mm are packing estimates, not cut lengths; trial-dress with slack and verify engagement/continuity before power. |
| Unused legacy headers | Prior PH8/1×8 reference assets remain in `step/` and `obj/` | Historical models only; neither is installed. J6 now uses the exact imported C5517754 part above. |
| Bearing | [Maysme 6712ZZ](https://maysmeprecision.com/Show/?Cid=677), catalogue 60×75×7 mm, chrome steel / two metal shields | Verified boundary envelope, presented as one complete bearing object. Chamfered races, two recessed shields, 44 balls and cage use explicitly accepted approximate internals; see `../bearing-model.json`. The same-size open NSK NB712A provides the mounting analogue, not certified Maysme race data. Four independent race contacts and tolerance envelopes are checked; see [FIT.md](../FIT.md). |
| PCB capture pads | [Rogers PORON 4701-30](https://www.rogerscorp.com/-/media/project/rogerscorp/documents/elastomeric-material-solutions/poron/english/data-sheets/17-006-poron-4701-30-very-soft.pdf), 320 kg/m³ / 1.57 mm ±10% | Four Ø4 mm and two Ø2.6 mm die-cut discs. CAD shows 1.05 mm compressed foam with 0.05 mm 467MP adhesive under the E7 lid. Compression is an engineering fit budget, not a supplier validation of this assembly. |
| Screws | DIN 965 / ISO 7046-1 M2, 3.8 mm head diameter, 1.2 mm head height | Nominal screw bodies with approximate cross recesses; fine threads omitted. The printed 4.2 mm countersinks leave clearance. |

The screen is rigidly transformed by `diag(-1,+1,-1)` then translated to Z=14.95 mm: its tab points -X, PCB underside is Z=14.5 mm, front is Z=18.1 mm and rear connector reaches Z=8.9 mm. No axis has been rescaled. The four bore axes are (±9.3, ±13.35) mm; the real rear boss faces sit at Z12.0 mm. Two wide walls support all four bosses; two short pins locate the screen. The enclosure screws are separate from these bores, whose thread is not established. [Screen audit](../screen-fit.json). This orientation allows a fixed cable to J6 and requires the matching E7 carrier/bezel support pattern and MADCTL setting.

## Rebuilding

`generate-models.py` imports the listed KiCad STEP files from `/usr/share/kicad/3dmodels` and tessellates at 0.03 mm chordal deflection through `../step-mesh.py`; `custom-models.py` generates the documented nominal sensor model and retained historical toggle model. Runtime: Python 3.12, `cadquery-ocp==8.0.1.1.0`, `trimesh==5.2.0`, `numpy`, `manifold3d==3.5.4`. The checked-in source STEP/OBJ files permit inspection without a KiCad installation. `models.json` records local paths, upstream URLs and measured bounds.

The supplier screen OBJ is an unchanged geometry tessellation of the original STEP; only vertex colours were added. Regenerate it with `step-mesh.py` and retain its source frame; the assembly generator applies the rigid transform.

The E7 print/assembly/render scripts were rechecked with Python 3.14, trimesh 4.12.2, NumPy 2.5.4, Manifold3D 3.5.4, matplotlib 3.11.2, pyrender 0.1.45, Pillow 13.0.0 and Mesa EGL. For this Python runtime, install pyrender and then upgrade its older OpenGL pin with `python -m pip install --no-deps PyOpenGL==3.1.10`; that is the version used for the checked renders. Supplier STEP tessellations were retained, not regenerated.

## Rights

Original Waveshare CAD remains Waveshare material, supplied in its public module resources; it is not relicensed as project MIT code. The KiCad STEP headers retain their authors, CC-BY-SA-4.0 licence and ECAD design exception. Those notices also apply to derivative package meshes; the exception permits generated electronic designs without imposing the library's share-alike licence on this project. Other supplier/EasyEDA assets retain their existing rights. Our parametric geometry and scripts are MIT. See the original STEP headers and [KiCad licence](https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-packages3D/-/blob/master/LICENSE.md).
